visual_name: Day in the life, part eight: twenty three pages (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js copy shop and box-built character, a jamming copier, contract / initials / scan / agreement pages, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.8 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a 23-page contract to print, sign, scan and send back, a jammed copier, initials on every page, a thumb in every scan, version two; then YourBrand: the agreement on the campaign page, signed there, countersigned, brief unlocked, signed PDF. The pages become coasters.
